item.title: Iconic Wienermobile to make five appearances in North Texas
item.description: The Oscar Mayer Wienermobile will be visiting the Dallas-Fort Worth area from Feb. 27 to March 6, 2026, making five appearances at local grocery stores and farmers markets, offering attendees Wiener Whistles and other activities.

item.title: A mini milk dispensing fridge now exists (and this brand is giving them away)
item.description: Oreo Puffs Cereal is giving away three limited-edition mini fridges that dispense chilled milk in celebration of National Oreo Day and National Cereal Day.

item.title: Great Wolf Lodge Texas offers $18.36 day passes
item.description: Great Wolf Lodge is offering indoor water park day passes for $18.36 per person at its Texas locations from March 2-5 to celebrate Texas Independence Day.

item.title: Puttshack launches nationwide STEM program
item.description: Puttshack has launched its "ACE the Course" education program, a STEM-certified program designed for use during field trips and camp programs for children in grades one through six, which combines mini golf gameplay with hands-on science, technology, engineering and math modules.

item.title: 'Landman' actress Gail Cronauer talks acting in D-FW
item.description: Gail Cronauer, an actor, teacher, coach, and DFW SAG-AFTRA Second VP, shares her insights and journey to landing a role in Landman, now streaming on Paramount Plus, in an interview with CW33.

item.title: Local event highlights Native American Awareness
item.description: "Other Steps, Another Time: Native American Awareness Day" will be held on March 7 at the Plaza Theatre, featuring educational exhibits, performances, demonstrations, and a keynote address from a prominent historian.

item.title: Dallas hosts sunset and sunrise flow yoga classes for all
item.description: The Village Dallas is hosting a free outdoor yoga series featuring Sunset Flow on Wednesdays and Sunrise Flow on Saturdays, attracting over 300 attendees per session, with post-class social hours on the last Wednesday of each month.

item.title: Experience 'Wicked' magic at Plaza Theatre's double feature
item.description: Plaza Theatre will host two screenings of the musical fantasy "Wicked & Wicked: For Good Double Feature" on March 18, allowing fans to relive the spellbinding story of Elphaba and Glinda.

item.title: Dallas Ballet Company presents annual 'En avant' event
item.description: The Dallas Ballet Company will hold its annual dance event, "En Avant," on March 8, featuring dancers from every level of the organization and guest performances.

item.title: Pitmasters announced for Lone Star Smokeout 2026
item.description: The Lone Star Smokeout festival will return in 2026 with 15 pitmasters from across the country, musical headliners Riley Green, Koe Wetzel and Shaboozey, and more.
